note: Covenant-only reference excerpts. Merge into the full project definitions; do not replace shared files with these subsets.

power._modele: Covenant — Sovereign and God-tier rules: docs/COVENANT.md

moves.name: Change Stance
moves.desc: Switch between Legislation, Contracts, Immunity, Constitution, Sovereignty and Registry.

moves.name: Enact
moves.desc: Write a law and penalty in chat: No one may run. Penalty: their Speed. It binds all signers (10 aura). Crouch: repeal the latest law.

moves.name: Terms of Entry
moves.desc: Write entry conditions: Whoever enters gives up their weapons. Collected when crossing the boundary (8 aura). Crouch at High tier: seal a permanent Court here.

moves.name: Fine Print
moves.desc: Hide one law while keeping it enforced. Crouch: reveal a hidden law.

moves.name: Foreclosure
moves.desc: Collect a signer's outstanding debt plus 25% interest (20 aura). Crouch: Exile after three breaches (25 aura).

moves.name: Pact
moves.desc: Offer the targeted person a private deal: my life for your branch. Reply accept to bind both parties (12 aura). Crouch: summon a held soul (15 aura).

moves.name: Endowment
moves.desc: Lend collateral to the targeted ally until the Court closes or their first breach (8 aura). Crouch: select collateral.

moves.name: Proxy
moves.desc: Transfer your wounds to the targeted signer until the Court closes. Crouch: release the Proxy.

moves.name: Appropriation
moves.desc: Use a stolen branch at its original owner's strength, without access to unrelated moves. God tier: wield ten branches simultaneously.

moves.name: Sovereign Immunity
moves.desc: Your own laws do not bind you by default. Press to bind yourself or restore your immunity.

moves.name: Indemnity
moves.desc: Void wounds and penalize their author. Six seconds below 5.0; permanent from 5.0 while your personal Court is active. Press again to lift it.

moves.name: Escrow
moves.desc: Protect one of your stats from collection. Crouch: select a branch protected against theft, sealing and copying.

moves.name: Arbitration
moves.desc: Suspend the targeted debtor's ability until their debt is paid (20 aura).

moves.name: Constitution
moves.desc: Write a permanent law binding all signed people at any distance. Maximum five. Use cv repeal <id> to repeal one.

moves.name: Retroactive Law
moves.desc: Write a law that immediately penalizes recorded acts committed inside this Court during the preceding hour.

moves.name: Total Forfeit
moves.desc: Write a law with Penalty: whole ability. Its clause can collect the offender's entire ability.

moves.name: Class Action
moves.desc: Collect one penalty from every debtor simultaneously, without a participant limit.

moves.name: Jurisdiction
moves.desc: Write a territory name or here. The district becomes an autonomous Court for 24 hours.

moves.name: Sovereign Pact
moves.desc: Write PlayerName | deal. Offer a private Pact without a range restriction. Refusal grants one hour of immunity to your Pacts.

moves.name: Sovereign’s Due
moves.desc: Write a tribute: Speed, Recovery, memory. Every signed person pays once per day.

moves.name: Writing on the Hand
moves.desc: Write PlayerName | message to contact a marked signer at any distance.

moves.name: Ledger
moves.desc: List collateral and laws; from 5.0, show debts and remaining resources. God tier: signer locations and Pacts.

moves.name: Return Collateral
moves.desc: Return selected collateral to its owner. Use cv select N to select and cv return N to return directly.

moves.name: Spend Collateral
moves.desc: Spend selected collateral to restore 20 aura and release its penalty.

moves.name: Summon Soul
moves.desc: Summon the online owner of a held soul from any dimension. Pact souls persist after Court closure and server restart.

ability.name: Covenant
ability.description: Stepping into his court is signing his contract. The Sovereign writes laws and collects their penalties as Collateral. Court range: 10–500 m. Permanent Indemnity from 5.0. God tier (6.0+): Constitutions, Retroactive Laws, whole-ability forfeiture, 24-hour jurisdiction and one-week remote signatures. See docs/COVENANT.md.

impl.notes: CovenantRules, Specials17, persistent ledger and client signatures; docs/COVENANT.md.

snapshots.description: The Sovereign of a golden Court. Myriam enacts laws, collects Collateral and wields every God-tier Covenant technique.
